message.content: According to the discussion on 20260522, IllidanStormrage suggests planning some quiet hours when the children are playing to minimize disturbances. He also proposes including soft ground cover or mats to cushion any falls, which would be beneficial for the children's safety. Additionally, he recommends adding some fun play equipment, such as swings or a small climbing structure, to keep the kids entertained and active while ensuring their safety. These suggestions aim to balance the work and play aspects of the garden renovation project.
